  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "cl_pioneering",
      "claim_text": "The Transparent Reporting Project\u2019s customer survey represents a pioneering effort\u2014the first  known survey \ndesigned to collect assessments of transparent reporting on integrated data using common items across users of \nseveral statistical products produced by different agencies.",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "represents a pioneering effort",
      "location": "fcsm-19-01-transparent-reporting-for-integrated-data-quality#c0005"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_105_contacted",
      "claim_text": "In total across \nthe project agencies, 105 selected users were contacted to participate in the survey.",

      "evidence_grade": "measured_practitioner",
      "anchor": "105 selected users were contacted",
      "location": "fcsm-19-01-transparent-reporting-for-integrated-data-quality#c0005"

    {
      "id": "cl_two_instruments",

      "evidence_grade": "measured_practitioner",
      "anchor": "developed two instruments",
      "location": "fcsm-19-01-transparent-reporting-for-integrated-data-quality#c0005"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_68_items",
      "claim_text": "Altogether, there were 68 distinct items:  47 common items that appeared on both instruments, 6 items",
      "claim_type": "empirical",
      "evidence_grade": "measured_practitioner",
      "anchor": "68 distinct items",
      "location": "fcsm-19-01-transparent-reporting-for-integrated-data-quality#c0005"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_dimensions_compatible",
      "claim_text": "The eight dimensions of data quality adopted for the Transparent Reporting Project (relevance, \naccuracy, reliability, timeliness, punctuality, consistency, comparability, and access) are compatible with, and \nimplications of, a set of core concepts (quality, objectivity, utility, and integrity) in information quality guidelines",

      "evidence_grade": "inference",
      "anchor": "are compatible with",
      "location": "fcsm-19-01-transparent-reporting-for-integrated-data-quality#c0005"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_docs_provide_info",

      "id": "cl_overall_response_rate",
      "claim_text": "Of the 105 users who were asked to participate in the survey, 46 participated \nfor an overall response rate of 43.8 percent (46/105).",

      "evidence_grade": "measured_practitioner",
      "anchor": "43.8 percent",
      "location": "fcsm-19-01-transparent-reporting-for-integrated-data-quality#c0005"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_ic_response_rate",
      "claim_text": "Only 8 of the 31 informed \nconsumers contacted for the survey chose to participate, representing a response rate of about 25.8 percent.",

      "evidence_grade": "measured_practitioner",
      "anchor": "25.8 percent",
      "location": "fcsm-19-01-transparent-reporting-for-integrated-data-quality#c0005"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl_researcher_response_rate",
      "claim_text": "Researchers participated at a rate of 51.3 percent, with 38 researchers participating out of 74 contacted.",

      "evidence_grade": "measured_practitioner",
      "anchor": "51.3 percent",
      "location": "fcsm-19-01-transparent-reporting-for-integrated-data-quality#c0005"
